selection: Latest up to 60 complete retained summary records, selected before inspecting displacement or admission values; every selected record retained with no outcome/value filtering.
plotted_field: parameter_update_l2 copied exactly to CSV parameter_displacement_l2

scope: Recorded candidate parameter-space displacement. Inspected loop computes it from the trainable-parameter snapshot before warm restart to the candidate after optimization, before admission.
